title: Choosing the Best Material
seo_title: Grade 2 Choosing Materials Worksheets: Test Materials and Pick the Best
standard_text: Analyze data obtained from testing different materials to determine which materials have the properties that are best suited for an intended purpose.
meta_desc: Free grade 2 science worksheets on choosing materials (NGSS 2-PS1-2): match materials to jobs, read simple test results and pick the best material. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_big: Match the material to the job.
key_sub: Test materials, then use the data to pick the best one.
body_html:
How to think about it

Pick the material whose properties fit the job.

  • Think: what must it do?
  • Test the materials the same way.
  • Use the data to choose.
Example

Best material for a raincoat: paper, cloth or plastic?

A raincoat must keep water out.

Answer: plastic

Example

Bridge test: paper held 4 pennies, cardboard held 20. Strongest?

Bigger number = held more.

Answer: cardboard

Common mistakes

  • Choosing a material because of its color.
  • Always picking the biggest number. Sometimes smaller is better, like fewer drops leaking.
  • Testing materials in different ways, so the test is not fair.

faq.q: How do you choose the best material?
faq.a: Think about what the object must do, test the materials the same way, and pick the one with the best results.

faq.q: Why is a fair test important?
faq.a: If every material is tested the same way, you can trust the results.

faq.q: Is a bigger number always better?
faq.a: No. For leaks or drying time, a smaller number is better.
